# _template (model card)

Reference block — copy this folder to add a model, then fill in `block.json` and `src/`.

- **Task:** <what it predicts / produces>
- **Inputs / outputs:** <image → mask / features / …>
- **Status:** `raw` (Python adapter + offline mock). Promote to `ready` (CoreML) only when an app
  needs it on device.
- **Source / license:** <repo url> / <license>
- **Apple-native:** <does Vision/CoreML/ARKit already do this? verdict + why the model is still needed>

## Use
```python
from blocks._template.src import build
model = build(offline=True)     # deterministic mock (real backend when weights are on the box)
model.predict("input")
```

## Wiring the real backend
Implement `TemplateModel.predict` in `src/model.py` (lazy-import torch/coreml), and make
`is_available()` return True only when deps + weights are present. Until then, `build()` returns
the mock so the block stays green in CI.
